summary: A large named legal team and a form on the page are strengths, but leftover text and thin proof appear to cost you client enquiries.

findings.problem: The form asks for Phone / WhatsApp but the page lists only two unlabeled phone numbers and no WhatsApp link, and it requires a Corporate Email Address.
findings.cost: Clients who prefer WhatsApp or use a personal email may not enquire.
findings.fix: WhatsApp button and a simpler form.

findings.problem: Drag or use arrows appears twice, every team card ends with Profile, and the eight certification logos appear to repeat.
findings.cost: Template leftovers make the page look unfinished.
findings.fix: Clean carousels and one logo set.

findings.problem: Twelve Read more and six Read More links give no context, and Foreign Investment and Corporate Governance footer links appear to go to the general practice page.
findings.cost: Clients looking for a specific service cannot find it quickly.

findings.problem: The awards give no year or category, client logos have no matter context, and two COVID-19 articles from 2020 sit beside 2026 content.
findings.cost: Old news and unspecific awards weaken proof of current work.

redesign: WhatsApp and a simpler enquiry form.
Dedicated practice pages and clean layout.
Dated awards, case studies and current news.
